description: Sunday shopping and shop opening hours in the 26 Swiss cantons from the official law texts (re-checked weekly): how many Sundays all shops may open per year (federal Labour Act: at most four without a permit, each canton decides), who decides (canton or commune), weekday and Saturday closing times, Advent rules, tourist-place exceptions, the law with its URL and a verbatim quote. Shops in large stations, airports and motorway service areas may open every Sunday (federal law). With canton (2-letter code): that canton.
name: sunday_shopping
title: Sunday shopping rules
